import bpy

# Remove only an earlier copy of this diagnostic marker.
old = bpy.data.objects.get('CHATGPT_TESTE_VISIVEL')
if old:
    bpy.data.objects.remove(old, do_unlink=True)

coll = bpy.data.collections.get('ChatGPT_Visible_Test')
if coll is None:
    coll = bpy.data.collections.new('ChatGPT_Visible_Test')
    bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(coll)
coll.hide_viewport = False
coll.hide_render = False

# Create a deliberately huge visible marker at the origin.
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=10.0, location=(0.0, 0.0, 5.0))
obj = bpy.context.object
obj.name = 'CHATGPT_TESTE_VISIVEL'
for c in list(obj.users_collection):
    c.objects.unlink(obj)
coll.objects.link(obj)

mat = bpy.data.materials.get('CHATGPT_RED_TEST') or bpy.data.materials.new('CHATGPT_RED_TEST')
mat.diffuse_color = (1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
obj.data.materials.clear()
obj.data.materials.append(mat)

obj.hide_set(False)
obj.hide_viewport = False
obj.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj

# Force every visible 3D view to frame this marker.
framed = 0
for window in bpy.context.window_manager.windows:
    screen = window.screen
    for area in screen.areas:
        if area.type != 'VIEW_3D':
            continue
        region = next((r for r in area.regions if r.type == 'WINDOW'), None)
        if region is None:
            continue
        with bpy.context.temp_override(window=window, screen=screen, area=area, region=region):
            bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
            obj.select_set(True)
            bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj
            bpy.ops.view3d.view_selected(use_all_regions=False)
        framed += 1

# Show an unmistakable popup in the Blender process that executed this command.
def draw(self, context):
    self.layout.label(text='CHATGPT ESTA CONECTADO NESTE BLENDER')
    self.layout.label(text='Procure o cubo vermelho CHATGPT_TESTE_VISIVEL')
try:
    bpy.context.window_manager.popup_menu(draw, title='Teste da ponte ChatGPT', icon='INFO')
    popup = True
except Exception as e:
    popup = False
    popup_error = str(e)

print(f'SCENE={bpy.context.scene.name}; FILE={bpy.data.filepath!r}; OBJECT={obj.name}; FRAMED={framed}; POPUP={popup}')
